payload.zoningSummary: Single-family residence standard lot (SF-2) district is the designation for a moderate density single-family residential use on a lot that is a minimum of 5,750 sq ft. An SF-2 district designation may be applied to a use in an existing single-family neighborhood that has moderate sized lots or to new development of single-family housing on lots that are 5,750 sq ft or more.
payload.permittedUses: PERMITTED USES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO: AGRICULTURE-OTHER, ASSEMBLY/ MEETING PLACE, GARDEN CENTER, DAY CARE FACILITY, HOUSING-SINGLE UNIT, HOUSING-MULTIPLE UNITS, HOUSING-SENIOR, BED & BREAKFAST, EDUCATIONAL/SCHOOL, COMMUNICATIONS TOWER

payload.minimumLotAreaFullDescription: 5,750 sq ft; minimum corner lot area: no requirement established
